title: 롤플레이 (11~13번)
intro: OPIc 11~13번은 한 상황이 질문하기(11번) → 문제 해결(12번) → 관련 경험(13번)으로 이어지는 롤플레이 구간입니다. 상대 대답 없이 혼자 말하므로 음성 메시지를 남기듯 한 번에 쭉 이어 말하면 됩니다. 상황은 늘 내 페르소나로 바꿔 생각하세요: 20년 같이 일한 동료 Minho와의 주말 영화, 아이 둘과 함께 가는 제주 가족 여행, 대전 부모님 댁 방문, 작년 여름 오사카 여행처럼 이미 준비한 이야기를 재활용하면 훨씬 자연스럽습니다.
strategy: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장('Hi, I'm calling to ask about ~.') → 내 상황 한 줄(동료 Minho와 / 가족 넷이) → 질문 3~4개 또는 문제 설명 + 대안 2개 → 마무리 문장('Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.')
11번(질문하기)은 First / Also / And one more thing 으로 질문을 3~4개 이상 이어 갑니다. 시간·가격·할인·좌석·포함 사항·주차 중에서 고르세요.
12번(문제 해결)은 'I'm afraid there's a problem with ~.' → 무슨 일이 생겼는지 한두 문장 → 'How about ~ instead? / If not, could I ~?' 로 대안 2개 이상 → 'Please call me back.' 으로 끝냅니다.
13번(경험)은 일반 경험 문제와 같습니다. 언제 → 무슨 일 → 내가 한 행동 → 결과·느낀 점을 과거시제로 말하고, 회사 급한 일 때문에 바뀐 대전 방문, 오사카 티켓 날짜 실수처럼 페르소나 이야기를 쓰세요.

expressions.en: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the new sci-fi movie this Saturday.
expressions.ko: 안녕하세요, 이번 주 토요일 새 SF 영화 때문에 전화드렸어요.
expressions.note: 11번 만능 시작 문장. about 뒤만 바꾸기

expressions.en: What time does the evening show start?
How much are the tickets for two adults?
Does the price include the flights?
expressions.note: include 뒤에 breakfast, a rental car 등으로 바꾸기

expressions.en: I'm afraid there's a problem with my booking.
Please call me back at this number.
There are four of us, two adults and two kids.
expressions.ko: 어른 둘, 아이 둘, 모두 네 명이에요.

expressions.en: Is it possible to move my tickets to Sunday instead?
expressions.ko: 티켓을 대신 일요일로 옮길 수 있을까요?
expressions.note: Is it possible to + 동사원형 = 정중한 요청

expressions.en: If that doesn't work, could I get a refund?
expressions.ko: 그게 안 되면 환불받을 수 있을까요?

expressions.en: Something came up, so he can't make it.
expressions.ko: 일이 생겨서 그 친구가 못 온대요.

expressions.en: I only have five days off from work.
I'd really appreciate it if you could find us another flight.
expressions.ko: 다른 항공편을 찾아 주시면 정말 감사하겠어요.

expressions.en: The kids have been counting down the days for weeks.
expressions.ko: 아이들이 몇 주 전부터 날짜를 손꼽아 기다렸어요.

expressions.en: Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Thanks!
expressions.ko: 네, 여쭤보고 싶은 건 그게 다예요. 감사합니다!
expressions.note: 롤플레이 마무리 문장. 12번은 'Yeah, that's the situation.'

questions.en: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to see a movie with a friend this weekend. Call the movie theater and ask three or four questions about the movie.
questions.ko: 상황을 드릴 테니 연기해 보세요. 이번 주말에 친구와 영화를 보려고 합니다. 영화관에 전화해서 영화에 대해 질문 3~4개를 하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm calling to ask about ~.' → 오래 함께한 동료 Minho와 볼 거라는 상황 한 줄 → 질문 3~4개(시간·가격·할인·좌석·주차) → 'Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.'
질문마다 First / Also / And one more thing 을 붙이면 개수가 분명하게 들립니다.
IH 이상은 '토요일 오전엔 아이들과 시간을 보내서 저녁이 좋다', '차를 가져간다'처럼 내 상황에 맞춘 이유를 한 줄씩 붙이세요.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the new sci-fi movie this Saturday. My coworker Minho and I want to see it together. He's also a good friend of mine. I have a few questions. I'd like to know what time the evening shows start. Also, how much are the tickets for two adults? Do you have any discounts for members? And one more thing, are there any good seats left in the middle? Okay, thank you so much. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Bye!
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the new sci-fi movie this Saturday. My coworker Minho and I have worked together for almost 20 years, and we're both big sci-fi fans, so we finally decided to see it together. I have a few questions. I'd like to know what time the evening shows start. I usually spend Saturday mornings with my kids, so anything after six would be perfect. Also, how much are the tickets for two adults? I have a membership card, so is there any discount I can use? And are there still good seats left in the middle? We don't like sitting too close to the screen. Oh, and one more thing, is there free parking in the building? I'm going to drive there. Okay, that's really helpful. Thank you. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Have a good day!
answers.AL: Hi there, I'm calling to ask about the new sci-fi movie this Saturday. My coworker Minho and I have been dying to see it. It's more fun to watch a big movie like this with someone than by myself. We've worked together for almost 20 years, and we just wrapped up a really tough project, so we decided to treat ourselves to a night out. So I have a few questions, if you don't mind. First, I'd like to know what time the evening shows start. I usually take my kids to the park on Saturday mornings, so anything after six would work best. Also, how much are the tickets for two adults? I've got a membership card for your theater, so I was wondering if there's any kind of discount. And are there still good seats left in the middle? Honestly, at our age, we get a sore neck if we sit too close to the screen. Oh, and one more thing, is the movie showing in IMAX? If it is, we'd love to see it on the big screen, since the special effects are supposed to be amazing. Lastly, is there free parking in the building, or should we just take the subway? Okay, that's super helpful. Thanks a lot for your time. So yeah, that's pretty much everything I wanted to ask. Have a great day!

questions.en: I'd like to give you a situation and ask you to act it out. You want to go on a trip during your vacation. Call a travel agency and ask three or four questions about a trip package you are interested in.
questions.ko: 상황을 드릴 테니 연기해 보세요. 휴가 때 여행을 가려고 합니다. 여행사에 전화해서 관심 있는 여행 상품에 대해 질문 3~4개를 하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm calling to ask about ~ package.' → 여름휴가에 가족 넷(아이 둘)이 간다는 상황 → 질문 3~4개(가격·방·포함 사항·아이 활동) → 'Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.'
가족 여행이라 'for two adults and two kids', 'activities for kids' 같은 질문이 자연스럽습니다.
AL은 취소 규정(cancellation policy)처럼 직장인다운 질문을 하나 더 넣고 이유를 붙이세요.

answers.IM3: Hi, I'm calling to ask about your Jeju Island package. I want to go there with my family during my summer vacation. There are four of us, two adults and two kids. I have a few questions. First, how much is the package for four people? Is it possible to get a room with an ocean view? Does the price include the flights and a rental car? And one more thing, are there any fun activities for kids? Okay, thank you. Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask.
answers.IH: Hi, I'm calling to ask about the Jeju Island package I saw on your website. I'm planning a trip with my family during my summer vacation in August. There are four of us, including my son, who's in middle school, and my daughter, who's in elementary school. So I have a few questions. First, how much is the four-day package for two adults and two kids? Is it possible to get a room with an ocean view? My kids love waking up and seeing the sea. Next, does the price include the flights and a rental car? We definitely need a car to get around the island. And one more thing, are there any activities for kids, like horse riding or a water park? Okay, that sounds great. Could you send me the details by email? Yeah, that's all I wanted to ask. Thanks a lot!
answers.AL: Hi there, I'm calling to ask about the Jeju Island package I saw on your website. I'm planning a family trip for my summer vacation in early August. There are four of us in total, including my son, who's in middle school, and my daughter, who's in elementary school. We went to Jeju a few years ago and had a blast, so the kids have been begging to go back. Anyway, I have a few questions, if you don't mind. First, how much is the four-day package for two adults and two kids? Also, is it possible to get a room with an ocean view? I ended up with a room facing the parking lot last time, which was a bit disappointing. Next, does the price include the round-trip flights and a rental car? To be honest, getting around the island without a car is a real pain. And one more thing, are there any activities for kids, like horse riding or snorkeling? My son gets bored pretty easily, so that would be a big plus. Lastly, what's your cancellation policy? Things come up at work all the time, so I'd like to know just in case. Okay, that's really helpful. Could you email me all the details? So yeah, that's pretty much everything I wanted to ask. Thanks so much!

questions.en: I'm sorry, but there is a problem I need you to resolve. You bought two movie tickets for this weekend, but your friend just told you that something came up and they can't come. Call the theater, explain the situation, and suggest two or three alternatives.
questions.ko: 죄송하지만 해결해야 할 문제가 생겼습니다. 이번 주말 영화 티켓 두 장을 샀는데, 친구가 방금 일이 생겨서 못 온다고 합니다. 영화관에 전화해서 상황을 설명하고 대안을 2~3개 제시하세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Hi, I'm calling about ~.' → 'I'm afraid there's a problem with ~.' → Minho의 아들이 아파서 못 온다는 상황 설명 → 대안 2~3개 → 'Yeah, that's the situation.'
대안은 How about ~ instead? / Is it possible to ~? / If that doesn't work, could I ~? 로 하나씩 꺼내세요.
IH 이상은 '대신 중학생 아들을 데려갈 수 있게 청소년 티켓으로 바꿔 달라'처럼 내 가족 상황을 대안에 넣으면 자연스럽습니다.

I didn't know what to do, so I decided to call you right away. So I have a couple of ideas. First, how about moving my tickets to Sunday evening instead? If that's not possible, could I get a refund for one ticket? Please call me back at this number. Thank you so much. Yeah, that's the situation. Bye!
